annotations.text: ROW 1 · THE MOBILE FLOW, left to right. One recording, from idle to Neo's reply.
Idle. Mic lives at the right of the composer, 44px target. Plus for attachments on the left.
Type one character and the mic swaps to send. Delete the text and the mic comes back. Same slot, no layout jump.
Hold the mic. Red dot, timer, live waveform. Slide left to cancel, slide up into the lock chip to go hands free. Release sends.
Locked. Thumb is free. Trash discards, pause holds the clip, Send is full width. Max 5:00.
Optional review step (a setting, off by default): listen back, re-record, or send.
Received. Neo's MP3 as a voice note: play, waveform fills as it plays, time, speed pill, transcript folded under.
ROW 3 · DESKTOP. Buzz's existing recorder row plus the lock (hold L or click the chip). Received card adds title, time left and transcript.
Four composer states stacked for comparison; only one shows at a time.
Buzz's attachment card with its audio player, plus title, remaining time and the transcript row. Download stays.
Direction A chosen. Transcript row is a toggle: tap the header to fold it away. Buzz remembers the choice per device; folded is the default in channels, open in DMs.
